name: Liton Technology Corp.
summary: Liton Technology Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of electro etched and formed aluminum foils. The company offers low, medium, and high voltage formed aluminum foils for anode; low voltage aluminum etched foils; conductive foil; and TAB foils. Its products are used in various industries and products, such as aerospace, high-speed rail, MRT systems, solar and wind power, computers, mobile phones, automobiles, home appliances, and industrial products. It has operations in Mainland China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Taiwan, and internationally.
